doc.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: His children, first partner and his wife's will
summary: Fuller describes his three children with his wife, a first relationship that ended, daughter's studies in Paris and inheritance.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: By the way, we mentioned your children. You have three?

Three from this wife. There are a couple others. A few of them used to live here in Washington. My first wife, I say wife, but we were never married. We had children. She was a dancer. We attempted to get married, but the mother toward the license. She figured that I was not worthy of marrying her daughter. So she ended it before it began. But, we had an association for 18 years because of the child.
Are your children involved in your music, and your legacy?

My daughter, to keep the ship afloat, she's very influential. Because, she did her last graduate work in Sorbonne, in Paris. She was used a lot once they found out that she was my daughter. That opened a few doors for her, which helped out because the euro was so low. I sent her $1000, which was only good for 300. It is said. “The euro is only 57!” (Laughs)
No, I mean in an academic sense. What was she studying?

French as a second language and marketing. That is the same thing my son out of Amherst, he studied finance. Nobody followed me. I guess were having an awful lot of trouble now. Maybe they should think of something else!
But do you think they were happy?
They better be because my wife left the property and everything to them. It was thought that I was going first because I was 23 years old and my wife.
She left my daughter as the inheritor of her will. But, by the staff so I can stay here as long as I want. I am undaunted.
I am talking to your personal legacy. Do you think it will protect that if they understand your stance?

I’m sure. Their intimate. My daughter especially, and the girls love their dad. She would give me anything. She is always concerned about my health and everything. And every time I play close around, she is there. Every girl that went to Smith, she brings the whole crowd in there.
